title: VTG Linden Folding Travel Alarm Clock – Gold Tone – Wind-Up – Cracked Cover
descriptionText:
Condition:
Pre-owned vintage condition. The plastic/glass cover is cracked near the 2 o’clock position (see photos). There is some rust and corrosion inside the hinge area and wear on the gold-tone metal frame. The clock winds and the hands move freely, but long-term accuracy and alarm function have not been fully tested. Sold as-is for display, repair, or parts.
📜 Description:
This vintage Linden wind-up travel alarm clock captures mid-century elegance in a compact, folding design. The gold-tone bezel, cream dial, and raised gold numerals give it a timeless, luxurious look. Perfect for collectors of mechanical clocks, vintage travel accessories, or restoration projects.
⚙️ Features:
Brand: Linden
Type: Mechanical wind-up travel alarm clock
Era: Circa 1960s–1970s
Case Material: Metal with faux leather brown covering
Dial: Cream with gold-tone raised numerals
Hands: Gold with luminous dots
Power Source: Wind-up (no batteries)
Functions: Time and alarm
Markings: “Japan” on movement backplate
Case Dimensions (approx.): 3.5” × 3.5” closed
💬 Notes:
Crack in clear cover (visible in multiple images)
Surface rust/corrosion on inner hinge area
Clock winds smoothly; alarm untested
Great for restoration or vintage display
